# Tau2 text interaction core

This vendored subset provides the text dialogue runner, tool routing, and environment assertion interface used by BizAgentBench. The original license is retained in `LICENSE`.

Upstream source: tau2-bench, commit `a2c024725189473d2d7cea3a5cfdbcc67478e41f`. This distribution retains the text simulation entry point used by BizAgentBench; unrelated batch and audio entry points are omitted.
